condition_label.description: The grade word supplied in the input, echoed exactly. Never your own grading.

summary.description: Two or three sentences stating the asset's overall condition and the single most important reason for it.

why_condition.description: Why the condition score is what it is, referring only to the evidence streams named in the input.

why_main_problem.description: What the dominant recurring problem is, how many corrective work orders evidence it, and which component it concentrates on.

why_deterioration.description: Whether the asset is getting worse and on what evidence. Say plainly when deterioration is inferred rather than measured.

why_rul.description: How remaining useful life follows from age, expected life and condition. Name any input that was an estimate.

why_recommendation.description: Why the recommendation supplied in the input follows from the evidence. You explain the decision; you never change it.
